chunks: It is narrated from Isḥāq ibn ʿAmmār, who said:

I asked Abā Ibrāhīm عليه السلام about the visitation of the House being delayed until the third day. He said: “Performing it earlier is more beloved to me, and there is no harm in it if you delay it.”

key_terms.زِيَارَةِ: the visitation rite, here referring to the pilgrimage visit to the Kaʿbah
key_terms.يَوْمِ: day, indicating the time of performance

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to delay Tawāf al-Ziyārah until the third day?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses the timing of visiting the House, referring to Tawāf al-Ziyārah during hajj. Imām Abū Ibrāhīm عليه السلام states that doing it earlier is preferable, while also clarifying that delaying it until the third day is permissible and carries no blame.
